page_title: CAG 4-1 LEC | Cagliari v Lecce 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Rares Burnete (Lecce) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
90+1' The foul by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Juan Luca Sacchi.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) coming on for Nadir Zortea.
85' 7:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
85' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
83' 4 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Adam Obert (Cagliari) was set free in the area by Razvan Marin and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top left corner. 4:1.
81' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Juan Luca Sacchi pulls out a yellow card.
80' 3 - 1 It's a goal! Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 3:1.
78' The game is interrupted. Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
78' It is time for a substitution. Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) is on for Lassana Coulibaly.
77' Marco Giampaolo decides to make a substitution. Tete Morente will be replaced by Rares Burnete (Lecce).
74' Substitution. Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) on for Mattia Felici.
73' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Ante Rebic (Lecce). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
73' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Ante Rebic (Lecce)! Let's see what he decides.
73' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Ante Rebic (Lecce) for a tough tackle.
65' 2 - 1 GOAL! And it’s a scrappy one as Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) uses his body to force the ball over the goal line from the corner kick.
65' It will be a corner kick for Cagliari.
63' Substitution. Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Thorir Johann Helgason walks off.
63' Here is a change. Nikola Krstovic is going off and Marco Giampaolo gives the last tactical orders to Ante Rebic (Lecce).
60' 1 - 1 Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes the ball into the roof of the net. What a lovely finish!
56' Substitution. Kevin Bonifazi (Lecce) in, Santiago Pierotti out.
55' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
54' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Razvan Marin (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch so that Antoine Makoumbou can be given a rest.
54' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) replacing Nicolas Viola.
54' Substitution. Michel Adopo makes way for Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
52' Today's referee Juan Luca Sacchi rightly decides to book Michel Adopo (Cagliari) for his harsh tackle.
51' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
50' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
49' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).

42' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Elia Caprile. 0:1.
42' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
40' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
38' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
38' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).
37' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar.
34' The ball goes out for a corner. Cagliari can continue in their attacking effort.
33' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
33' A quickly taken corner by Cagliari.

32' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Elia Caprile, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
32' Shots on target – 1:0.
30' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and balloons his close-range header high over the bar.
26' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
23' The game is interrupted as Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is flagged offside.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
19' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
17' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
16' Cagliari fail to score from a corner as Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) leaps to collect the ball.
12' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
10' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
6' The game is interrupted now, Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
4' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Cagliari will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Juan Luca Sacchi.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our minute-by-minute commentary of today's clash. You can enjoy a written form of everything important that will be happening on the pitch. Have fun.
